recurrence_policy.initial: Due until matching evidence is reviewed. Existing evidence can satisfy a first cycle; do not redo completed work without a reason.
recurrence_policy.subsequent: Add interval to verified completion date, clamping to the last valid day for month-based intervals. Dates are not reset merely by issue closure.
recurrence_policy.deduplication: At most one open instance per mission ID; carry overdue work forward. Emit at most three new mission issues per controller run.
recurrence_policy.priority: Incident and release blockers, then overdue security/recovery, then oldest due mission. List every due mission on the board even when issue creation is capped.
recurrence_policy.completion: Require evidence, outcome, reviewer, completed_at and next_due. Scheduled failures and missing reports remain UNKNOWN.

missions.title: Watchtower
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Reconcile CI, scheduled checks, incidents, and deployed versions.
missions.evidence: Run URLs and timestamps; deployed SHA or explicitly unknown; owner for every failed or stale check.
missions.acceptance: Every active profile has a current status; unknown is never green.

missions.title: Patch Patrol
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Triage dependency updates and the existing rolling security scan.
missions.evidence: Completed scanner reports, updater failures, findings with severity/owner/due date or reviewed risk acceptance.
missions.acceptance: Missing reports are UNKNOWN; reuse Security Scan - rolling instead of creating duplicate scan issues.

missions.title: Change Chronicle
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Catalog the previous complete calendar month and explain how landed changes moved the system.
missions.evidence: Excluded base and included head SHAs; complete Markdown/JSON catalogs; behavior/contract changes; unresolved deployment evidence.
missions.acceptance: Separate landed commits, unmerged proposals, package releases, and deployed revisions; cover each activated companion separately.

missions.title: Companion Sync
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Reconcile source ownership, companion versions, extraction drift, and submodule pins.
missions.evidence: Active dependency graph, repository/commit or artifact digest, compatibility receipt, owner and archive status.
missions.acceptance: Each active dependency has one canonical implementation; archived pointers are resolved or the affected profile stays blocked.

missions.title: Restore Point
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Restore state and roll back a release in an isolated environment.
missions.evidence: Backup ID, restore log, data/hash validation, elapsed time, measured RPO/RTO, rollback result.
missions.acceptance: Recovered data and service behavior verified; a backup existing is insufficient.

missions.title: Keyring Review
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Review service identities, signing keys, scopes, expiry, revocation, and rotation procedure.
missions.evidence: Redacted inventory of key IDs/owners/scopes; revocation and rotation drill; access review.
missions.acceptance: No orphan credentials or unexplained privilege; rotate on compromise immediately, not only on the calendar.

missions.title: Sensor Calibration
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Measure neural sensors and valence decisions against independent held-out cases.
missions.evidence: Runtime/model/schema/dataset hashes; false positives/negatives by class; missing/NaN/replay/drift cases; threshold rationale.
missions.acceptance: Benign drift and attacks evaluated separately; observations cannot silently update production models or trust.

missions.title: Security Season
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Review attack boundaries across API, cryptography, browser, agents, storage, and billing.
missions.evidence: Updated threat model; negative authorization/replay/tamper tests; real-backend receipts; findings with owners.
missions.acceptance: Critical findings resolved or deployment blocked; review scope and residual risk recorded, not a certification claim.

missions.title: History Expedition
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Review six months of changes, release provenance, old secrets, and architecture drift.
missions.evidence: Six monthly catalogs; release/tag/deployed-SHA crosswalk; historical scan completion; migration/deprecation decisions.
missions.acceptance: Every included interval has exact boundaries; no missing shallow history; no force-push or destructive history cleanup.

missions.title: World Map Review
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Reconcile architecture, contracts, maintainers, supported runtimes, and archive decisions.
missions.evidence: Current source map; profile-level dependency graph; contract/schema versions; named ownership and support windows.
missions.acceptance: Code, documentation, released artifacts, and actual deployment profiles agree or have tracked gaps.

missions.title: Supply and Recovery Review
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Review supply chain, licensing, provenance, recovery ownership, succession, and operating cost.
missions.evidence: SBOM/license review; upstream maintenance status; artifact provenance; recovery/access continuity drill; cost review.
missions.acceptance: Active products have supported dependencies and a tested recovery owner; claims stay within measured evidence.

missions.title: Release Boss Gate
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Approve one named deployment profile at one immutable revision before every release.
missions.evidence: Exact commit and artifact digest; CI; installed-artifact tests; backend/auth/negative tests; target-host receipt; rollback.
missions.acceptance: All gates in README pass for that profile; missing evidence prevents promotion.

missions.title: Incident Response
missions.owner: Maintainer; delegation recorded in the mission issue
missions.objective: Respond to compromise, data loss, or a severe regression immediately.
missions.evidence: Containment timeline, redacted evidence, affected revisions, owner, recovery and follow-up verification.
missions.acceptance: Containment and recovery verified; lessons create reviewed regressions; do not wait for a recurring mission.
